protocol.scope: Normal completion and footer append consume only new persisted entries; cold summary/rebuild scans remain. Footer totals are whole-session, optional live/rebuilt notices follow active branch. No provider pricing or causal cache claim.
protocol.design: One primitive physical cursor with stable visitor skips all headers, preserves public getEntries copy semantics and duplicate-id load behavior. Footer invalidates on manager/reload; notice resets on context generation and uses branch rebuild. Preview is before persistence, deduplicates latest response weakly, disabled notices have no scanning owner. Release at disable/rebind/stop.

same-file same-count reload, duplicate headers and ids, session switch/dispose
full reference scans retained as oracle; AST and exact visit/copy/rebuild counters

performance.target: warm next-message estimate and footer usage refresh visit only appended entries, no full-history array/Map
performance.gate: repeated non-target regression above max(5%, baseline p95 band) blocks; baseline band over 10% requires diagnosis before absolute latency claims

protocol.lifecycle: Bounded primitives/one optional previous record/weak latest identity; no message history cache or pool. Controlled GC after clear, manager replacement and dispose, plus event/queue gates.
protocol.limits: Offline synthetic and actual production methods; no native terminal or cloud cache-hit/price claim. Existing getContextUsage branch scan is separate and cannot be hidden by reporting the footer usage cache as whole-render O(1).

comparison.bandDefinition: Maximum absolute relative deviation of the five process p95 values from their median, as PF00 specifies. Earlier console summaries used full range/median incorrectly; raw samples retained and all archive comparisons recomputed correctly.
